name: Apache Guacamole
description: Clientless remote desktop gateway for SSH, VNC, and RDP.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      GUACD_HOSTNAME: {{serviceName}}-guacd
      POSTGRESQL_HOSTNAME: {{serviceName}}-db
      POSTGRESQL_DATABASE: guacamole
      POSTGRESQL_USER: guacamole
      POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-guacd
      - {{serviceName}}-db
  {{serviceName}}-guacd:
    image: guacamole/guacd:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-guacd
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: guacamole
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: guacamole
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
